comments.author: Jean
comments.body: It's not actually available in the English/internation version of the game yet. They will be added to the game when we get the East Asia expansion and can develop towns beyond 65,000. As the description says, at that point it can be purchased from the craft shop in Naples, Bordeaux, Salonica, or Bergen after investing 690,000 and when the town has at least 69,000 development.
